text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited at all times on both sides of Larchmere Avenue at the following locations: Larchmere Avenue south of Husband Drive Larchmere Avenue south of Whitfield Avenue Larchmere Avenue north of Dellbrook Crescent The proposed amendment will facilitate the installation of In-Road Flexible Speed Signs as part of the City's ongoing efforts to improve road safety and encourage compliance with the posted speed limit.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Larchmere Avenue, between Husband Drive and a point 40 metres south. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Larchmere Avenue, between Whitfield Avenue and a point 29.3 metres south. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Larchmere Avenue, between Dellbrook Crescent and a point 27 metres north.
